Largest differences: lever X to 6.92 (was 3.4) and its block Y to 12.88 (was 6.1), motor 36.2 dia (was 36.9), motor front 16.35 (was 16.0)

resolved_by_reference_cad: side of the 15.18 mm: CONFIRMED as assumed. The nozzle axis is 15.19 mm from the -Y face (23.31 from the +Y face), i.e. 4.06 mm to -Y of mid-width
the 3.3 mm holes: each runs through two 7 mm ears at |Y| = 12.25..19.25; the lower one continues through the body as a 6.5-6.7 mm channel; lower hole drawn 3.39 mm in the CAD, upper 3.30
the 38.5 mm width is the body's (and whole cold side's) Y extent; only the motor's flexible leads go past it

klipper.inconsistency: The page's summary gives 2682 steps/mm at 16x and 'Rotation distance (including the gear ratio): 26.8937' with gear ratio 11.262:1. 400 x 16 / 2682 = 2.386 mm of filament per MOTOR revolution = 26.8937 / 11.262. The published [extruder] block has rotation_distance 26.8937 and no gear_ratio line, which alone would give 238 steps/mm. So 26.8937 is per revolution of the hobb: Klipper needs 'gear_ratio: 11.262:1' with it, or rotation_distance 2.388 without. Check with a 100 mm extrusion test.

derived.note: 26.8937 / 11.262 = 2.38800; halved for a generator that cannot write full_steps_per_rotation: 400

reference_cad.title: E3D 'Roto Reference' CAD: REVO-ROTO-24V-AS-REFERENCE.STEP (STEP AP214 written by SolidWorks 2022 on 2024-01-24), linked from E3D's Roto data-sheet page
reference_cad.licence: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0, as stated on the Printables model page (read by the owner's agent, 2026-11-14). Non-commercial, no derivatives: the cut and split files in vendor_cad/ are for private use and must not be redistributed

split_into.cold_side: vendor_cad/EXTRUDER-E3D-ROTO.step (10 solids: everything but the hot side; the motor's four lead wires cut off at the lead block)

reference_cad.file_frame: nozzle tip at the origin, filament axis +Y (up), motor axis Z (motor at -Z, fan at +Z), width along X

file_to_catalogue_frame.note: catalogue X = -file Z - 9.058, Y = -file X - 4.06, Z = file Y - 33.55 (degrees about fixed X, Y, Z, then the translation)

measured_mm.note: measured in the STEP, in the catalogue frame (origin on the lower mounting-hole axis at mid-width, +X towards the motor, +Z up); exact to the file's 0.001 mm
measured_mm.mount_holes_note: both holes are in the gearbox cover and exist only in two 7 mm ears at |Y| = 12.25..19.25. Lower hole: a 6.5-6.7 mm channel between the ears (inside the body), so a screw passes the whole 38.5 mm. Upper hole: the ears stand free above the body, the 24.5 mm between them is open (the idler lever is there)
measured_mm.hotend_seat_note: top of the Revo hot side solid = heat-sink underside around the nozzle; it sits 1.0 mm up a 6.2 mm counterbore in a 7.36 mm boss that ends at Z = -11.75

flange.note: two lugs on one diagonal (-Y -Z and +Y +Z)

leads_as_drawn.note: drawn straight; flexible; data sheet: 40 mm

idler_lever.note: on the +Y side of the filament (filament at Y = -4.06): the filament enters the heat sink beside it. The file shows one position only: its travel is not in the CAD

cold_side_without_motor.note: X max is the tip of the two screws that hold the motor; the ring gear ends at 16.35

whole_file.note: 78.33 = 22.8 hot side + 55.53 up to the end of the leads; 56.23 = the 38.5 width + 17.73 of lead wire past the -Y face; 57.11 = fan screw heads to motor rear

not_in_the_file: the HeaterCore's lead sleeve and the fan cable
